fun_facts: ⚽ The Champions League anthem was composed by Tony Britten, based on Handel's 'Zadok the Priest'.
⚽ The official Champions League trophy is often called 'Ol' Big Ears' due to its large handles.
⚽ No club has successfully defended the Champions League title since Real Madrid's three-peat (2016-2018).
⚽ The competition's group stage format was introduced in the 1991-92 season.
⚽ A new club format (Swiss Model) was introduced from the 2024-25 season, replacing traditional groups.
⚽ The trophy is not given to the winning club permanently — clubs that win it 5 times or 3 times in a row get a special replica.
⚽ Real Madrid have never been eliminated in a Champions League round of 16 tie against a team they trailed after the first leg (historically dominant comebacks).
⚽ The final is always played at a neutral venue, decided years in advance.
⚽ Bayern Munich, Ajax, and Real Madrid are among clubs to have completed a continental treble.
